title: profile_consistency (N6) tool input: statements inside one investor profile that pull in different directions (docs/spec-factors.md 20.9)

abstain.description: true when the input does not allow a judgement; findings are then ignored.

fields.description: Paths of the declared fields involved, e.g. preferences.interests or objectives.goals[1].date.

quotes.description: One quote per path, in the same order: the value at that path as text; for values.notes an exact substring of the notes.

reason.description: At most 200 characters, no digits, no advice.
